title: Include inaccessible photons in the successful instrument
statement: A completely positive decomposition gives a reference-uniform conditional trace-distance bound without heralding the lost field.

evidence.quote: ## 3. Inaccessible photons are included in the guarantee

requires: One source qubit with FIXED H_S=Omega X/2,L_S=sqrt(gamma)Z,Omega>0,gamma>0,and Markov equation -i[H_S,rho]+gamma D[Z]rho. Coherent traveling measurement field BEFORE irreversible amplification,vacuum input;collection fraction0<eta<=1 reaches Bob,rest inaccessible. A reduced dephasing master equation alone does not supply this coherent interface. Two cold receiving qubits start00;R_j=sqrt(kappa)sigma_minus_j withkappa=Omega,active successively on[0,h] and[h,2h],h=pi/(2Omega),T=pi/Omega;inactive receiver stores state. Standard forward cascade preserves the prescribed source marginal,not an added direct source-receiver gate. Calibrated phases/couplings,accurate local filters/gates/storage and optional downstream photon-counter no-click flag with0<=zeta<=1 are explicit ideal-model premises. Original source is discarded WITHOUT measurement. Input is arbitrary unknown S,possibly entangled with inaccessible referenceA;filter requiresu<=1.
provides: L_S^dagger L_S=gamma I makes total source photon countPoisson(mu) independently of input/reference. Uniform loss splits collectedPoisson(lambda),lambda=eta mu,and lostPoisson((1-eta)mu). Cold downstream receivers preserve output photon number plus retained excitations. The detector no-click effect is(1-zeta)^N_out;no number resolution/arrival timing is needed andzeta0 means no detector.

For retained excitationk=0,1,2,filter probability weights arew0=u^4,w1=u^2,w2=1. Setf_k=exp(-lambda)*sum_(n>=k)(1-zeta)^(n-k)*lambda^n/n!. The full successful map isM_check=p0*id+E,E completely positive,with||E||diamond<=b=sum_(k0..2)w_k*[f_k-exp(-mu)*lambda^k/k!].

The subtracted term removes exactlyk collected/no-lost-photon events;remaining terms include collection loss,re-emission and missed clicks. F^dagger F is excitation-number diagonal,so photon-sector coherences do not invalidate this probability bound. The protocol does NOT demand a lost-field-vacuum measurement.

For everyrho_AS,p(rho)>=p0 and HALF trace distance between normalized successful (id_A tensorM_check)(rho)/p(rho) and originalrho withS relabeledRout is<=b/(p0+b). This is a reference-uniform single-use recovery statement. The conditional normalized operation can be nonlinear when success is state-dependent;the diamond norm here bounds the UNNORMALIZED CP errorE,not an invented normalized conditional channel.
assumptions: The source reports a completed ideal MARKOV successful instrument for this specific generator/interface,not a competitive finite-bandwidth device. Coherent field access before amplification,vacuum/cold initialization,collection/detection efficiencies,calibrated phases/couplings/local operations and coherent storage remain physical requirements. Collection loss is inaccessible,not measured for heralding. A failed attempt can CONSUME the unknown input;repeating cannot recover that same state. Do not equate single-use success/error with an asymptotic capacity,repeat-until-success transmission or fault tolerance. No receiver minimality/optimality is proved;source working history mentions a shaped one-receiver alternative without making it the final theorem. Joint finite-bandwidth instrument approximation,success-scaled error,overheads,efficiency curve and platform advantage remain OPEN. No new measured hardware,novelty/priority or general arbitrary-generator receiver capability is established.
